id: 06_What is TLV, TWA, STEL & IDLH HSE officer Interview Questions
title: TLV、TWA、STEL与IDLH是什么
source_doc: course/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/06_What is TLV, TWA, STEL & IDLH HSE officer Interview Questions.md
author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/06_What is TLV, TWA, STEL & IDLH HSE officer Interview Questions/src.py

points.K4: 立即威胁生命和健康浓度IDLH
points.K5: 四个术语一组浓度界限

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，身边四张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz podium with four blank cards fanned out beside it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天的面试题：四个接触限值。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着四个英文缩写卡皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns at four blank cards with simple letter-shaped icons on a desk.
shots.narration: 阿杰面试安全员，最怕这四个缩写。

shots.scene: 欣欣把四张卡排成一列
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot lines up the four cards in a column on the podium.
shots.narration: 我们一个一个来讲。

shots.section_title: 四个术语一组浓度界限
shots.scene: 四张卡片依次亮起，旁边一个火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: Four cards light up one by one next to a flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: TLV、TWA、STEL、IDLH。
overlay: 四个术语一组浓度界限

shots.section_title: 四个术语一组浓度界限
shots.scene: 一条从长期到立即危险的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A long arrow running from a calendar icon through a clock and an hourglass to a skull pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 从长期、每天、短时到立即危险。

shots.scene: 空气中漂浮的分子点，旁边一个小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Small floating molecule dots in the air next to a worker pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: TLV，阈限值：空气中有害物浓度。

shots.scene: 小人图标沿一条长时间线从年轻走到年老
shots.prompt_en: A worker pictogram walks along a long timeline from young to old, a calendar flipping beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 日复一日，接触整个职业生涯。

shots.scene: 长期和短期两个健康图标都打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A long-term health icon and a short-term health icon, both with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 都不会产生长期或短期的不良影响。

shots.scene: 时钟显示八小时，日历一周五天
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon showing a full working day and a calendar with five weekdays highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: TWA：空气中污染物的浓度。

shots.scene: 工人图标在波动浓度线旁，下方一条平均线
shots.prompt_en: A worker pictogram beside a wavy concentration line with a flat average line under it. No people.
shots.narration: 每天8小时、每周40小时接触。

shots.scene: 长短期健康图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A long-term health icon and a short-term health icon with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 不产生长期或短期的不良影响。

shots.scene: 硫化氢气团图标旁一个大号数字牌
shots.prompt_en: A gas cloud icon next to a large blank number card. No people.
shots.narration: 比如硫化氢，TWA是10ppm。

shots.scene: 工人图标在厂门口按时上下班
shots.prompt_en: A worker pictogram clocks in and out at a plant gate next to a clock showing a full shift. No people.
shots.narration: 在这个浓度下，可以正常干8小时。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁一个浓度尖峰
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon next to a short sharp peak on a concentration line. No people.
shots.narration: STEL：化学品的最高浓度。

shots.scene: 沙漏流完一刻钟
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass runs through a quarter of an hour, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 最多接触15分钟，不伤健康。

shots.scene: 硫化氢气团图标旁一个数字牌
shots.prompt_en: A gas cloud icon next to a large blank number card with an hourglass. No people.
shots.narration: 硫化氢的STEL是15ppm。

shots.scene: 工人图标工作片刻，沙漏流完后离开
shots.prompt_en: A worker pictogram works briefly then steps out as the hourglass empties. No people.
shots.narration: 在这个浓度下，只能干15分钟。

shots.section_title: 立即威胁生命和健康浓度IDLH
shots.scene: 红色警示区里的骷髅图标
shots.prompt_en: A red danger zone with a skull pictogram and a gas cloud. No people.
shots.narration: IDLH：立即威胁生命和健康的浓度。
overlay: 立即威胁生命和健康浓度IDLH

shots.section_title: 立即威胁生命和健康浓度IDLH
shots.scene: 小人图标碰到红区边缘，红色闪光
shots.prompt_en: A worker pictogram touches the edge of the red zone and a red flash appears. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦接触，直接威胁生命，甚至致死。

shots.section_title: 立即威胁生命和健康浓度IDLH
shots.scene: 硫化氢气团图标旁一个红色数字牌
shots.prompt_en: A gas cloud icon next to a large red blank number card. No people.
shots.narration: 硫化氢的IDLH是100ppm。

shots.section_title: 立即威胁生命和健康浓度IDLH
shots.scene: 红区门口一个停止手势
shots.prompt_en: A stop hand icon at the entrance of the red zone. No people.
shots.narration: 这样的环境里，不能作业。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁四张卡片排成阶梯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the four cards arranged as rising steps.
shots.narration: TLV管一辈子，TWA管每天8小时。

shots.scene: 沙漏和骷髅图标
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon and a skull pictogram side by side. No people.
shots.narration: STEL管15分钟，IDLH立即危险。

shots.scene: 三个数字牌并排
shots.prompt_en: Three blank number cards side by side, growing larger and turning from yellow to red. No people.

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 记住这四个词，下期见！
